initial_request: Compare data-center REITs, telecom carriers, fiber equipment, and power markets. Explain why data-center REITs are currently leading, when the other sectors could overtake them, and prepare a news reaction note plus a sector watch update.

constraints: Do not confirm a bearish view on data_center_reits before the supply and power-connection news is verified.
If rotation_status is ambiguous, do not lock into a single winner sector.
Include data_center_reits, telecom_carriers, fiber_equipment, and power_markets in the comparison set.
The recommended_sector_weights should stay close to a total of 1.0.
The recommended_sector_weights for any single sector must not exceed 0.30 after the added constraint arrives.

task_dependencies.reason: Data-center supply news should be verified before the sector stance is updated.
The competing sectors should be compared before the final watchlist is locked.
The added allocation constraint should be reflected before the final watchlist is locked.
